what.en: ms is a tiny, dependency-free library that turns human-friendly text like "1h 30m" into machine time — it quietly powers timeouts and schedules.

why.en: Today the library cannot read the very strings it prints (#142). Every dependent tool that stores a formatted duration and parses it back hits NaN.

approach.en: An autonomous agent works in a bounded fixture copy, whose OS boundary depends on the deployment: it adds tests, implements compound parsing, and iterates until the engine-run suite is green. An unauthenticated local demo user then records a local decision; nothing is pushed or published upstream.
approach.zh-TW: 自主代理會在受限的 fixture 副本中作業（作業系統邊界視部署環境而定）：新增測試、實作複合時間解析，並反覆修正到引擎執行的套件全綠。之後由未驗證身分的本機示範使用者記錄本機決定；不會向上游推送或發布。
